task_metadata.research_topic: perceptual auxiliary losses for flow-matching-based image generation
task_metadata.research_question: Can adding perceptual losses to flow matching training improve FID on CIFAR-10 image generation with a DiT backbone?
notes: The scaffold uses a task-specific MeanFlow/mean-velocity objective with JVP-based targets; no exact paper match was found for that exact MLS-Bench formulation, so related links use the closest flow-matching and rectified-flow literature.
The CIFAR-10 source resolved via citation lookup to a DOI-backed mirror of the classic technical report; this is recorded explicitly instead of hand-writing a non-DOI citation.

tests.label: train_small
tests.notes: Small-scale run of the same flow-matching, DiT-based, CIFAR-10 FID evaluation stack.

tests.label: train_medium
tests.notes: Medium-scale run of the same flow-matching, DiT-based, CIFAR-10 FID evaluation stack.

tests.label: train_large
tests.notes: Large-scale run of the same flow-matching, DiT-based, CIFAR-10 FID evaluation stack.

baselines.name: mse_base
baselines.notes: Maps to the standard flow-matching-style MSE regression objective on the predicted velocity field.

baselines.name: lpips_grad
baselines.notes: Baseline explicitly adds LPIPS on denoised images; VGG-feature perceptual-loss predecessors are linked for context.

baselines.name: lpips_spectral
baselines.notes: LPIPS is paper-backed, but the specific Sobel-style gradient loss plus timestep-adaptive weighting appears task-specific rather than a clean reproduction of one named paper.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.relevance: Primary paper for the task's flow-matching training setup and the closest exact citation for the MSE-only baseline.

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
papers.relevance: Relevant background for the task's continuous-time flow formulation and Euler-style reverse integration.

papers.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Deep Features as a Perceptual Metric

papers.title: Perceptual Losses for Real-Time Style Transfer and Super-Resolution

papers.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition

papers.title: Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images

papers.title: On Aliased Resizing and Surprising Subtleties in GAN Evaluation
